key_trends.description: Checkout.com maintained ethical stance throughout December: no ransom payment, donation to research, public transparency
key_trends.impact: Industry precedent for ethical incident response, community validation

key_trends.description: Android launched mandatory developer verification with early access starting Dec 14, balancing security and accessibility
key_trends.impact: Platform governance becoming standard, verification enables trust at scale
key_trends.source: Android Developer Verification (Dec 14), Hacker News 1,245 points

key_trends.description: iOS 26.2 fixed 20 vulnerabilities, 2 actively exploited, highlighting rapid patching urgency
key_trends.impact: Real-world exploitation happening, monitoring and rapid response critical
key_trends.source: iOS 26.2 Security Update (Dec 14), Hacker News 73 points

key_trends.description: Checkout.com incident throughout November-December reinforces legacy system decommissioning urgency from idea:186
key_trends.impact: Two major incidents emphasize importance of infrastructure audit and decommissioning process

key_takeaways.takeaway: Ethical ransomware response is the new standard
key_takeaways.detail: Checkout.com's sustained commitment: refuse ransom, donate to research, maintain transparency. Community strongly supports this approach.
key_takeaways.chained_action: Document ethical incident response plan with no-ransom policy BEFORE incident occurs

key_takeaways.detail: Android's 1,245 HN point verification launch shows platform owners taking responsibility. Balance security with accessibility for educational use.
2 iOS vulnerabilities exploited in wild before patches. Rapid monitoring and patching aren't optional—they're survival.
key_takeaways.chained_action: Extend error observer to security monitoring, establish rapid patching infrastructure

key_takeaways.takeaway: Legacy systems remain critical attack vectors
key_takeaways.detail: Checkout.com's third-party cloud storage from 2020 became breach point. Systems not decommissioned become time bombs.
key_takeaways.chained_action: Complete GCP infrastructure audit from idea:186, establish decommissioning process

key_takeaways.takeaway: Developer verification balances security and accessibility
key_takeaways.detail: Android's approach: verify developers, accommodate learners, allow power user opt-out with informed consent.
key_takeaways.chained_action: Apply to agent ecosystem: verify production agents, accommodate educational agents

integration_proposals.description: Document no-ransom policy, donation commitment, transparency requirements, public accountability
integration_proposals.expected_impact: Clear action plan reduces incident response time from days to hours, builds community trust

integration_proposals.description: Implement verification levels (verified/trusted/experimental/educational), define permissions, public documentation
integration_proposals.expected_impact: Trust at scale, security boundaries, accommodation for learning/prototyping

integration_proposals.description: Extend error observer to security events, dependency scanning, rapid deployment process
integration_proposals.expected_impact: Early vulnerability detection, faster patching, reduced exploitation window

integration_proposals.description: Public security page (docs/security.md), agent governance transparency, community feedback mechanism
integration_proposals.expected_impact: Community trust, competitive differentiation, transparent security posture
